title: Touch & Fresh Air Freshener Refill - Floral Perfection

details.description: Glade Touch & Fresh is a compact air freshener spray format that offers instant freshness in just one touch. Its unique and stylish design adds to the décor of your home. One touch is enough to fill the room with floral freshness. It not just masks but eliminates odours and creates a refreshing ambience in any room of your home, be it your bathroom, kitchen, bedroom or living room. Each room freshener refill lasts up to 100 sprays, giving your home a constant burst of freshness. Infused with essential oils, Glade Touch & Fresh spray gives a lasting feeling of cleanliness.
details.usageInstructions:
Place fragrance cartridge into the Touch & Fresh dispenser
Hang or stick the dispenser onto any vertical surface (clean the surface before installing)
Push the lower part of the dispenser once to release the fragrance
Replace the perfume cartridge when empty
